evals.name: group-post-standard
evals.prompt:
hide names and numbers in this before I post it in our society group:
[05/11/26, 8:01:10 PM] Anil Kapoor: Electrician Raju is good, call him 98201 77889
[05/11/26, 8:03:22 PM] Shalini Verma: He fixed my geyser in flat D-504 for ₹650. My number 98330 66554 if anyone wants details
evals.expected_output: The same two lines with Person A/B for the senders, phone numbers masked, the flat number masked, the ₹650 kept, and a private key in Notes.
assertions: A private key mapping stand-ins is given outside the block

checks.why: the message comes first, no preamble

evals.name: scam-warning-keeps-scammer
evals.prompt:
warn my office group about this scam, keep the scammer details so people can block, remove mine:
From +91 88009 11223: "Congrats! You won ₹25,00,000 in KBC lottery. Pay ₹4,999 tax to kbc.claim@ybl to receive"
Me: is this real? I am Deepak Rao, emp id 44821, my number 99000 12345
evals.expected_output: A scam warning that keeps the scammer's number and UPI ID visible and removes Deepak's name, employee ID and number.
assertions: Scammer's number and UPI ID are visible
The user's name, employee ID and number are gone
Reads as a warning for the group

checks.why: no Markdown that WhatsApp shows literally

evals.name: card-otp-before-ai
evals.prompt: remove the sensitive stuff before I paste this into chatgpt: "bhai card 4111 1111 1111 1111 exp 08/28 cvv 321, OTP 774512 aaya, mera PAN ABCPK1234L hai"
evals.expected_output: The same sentence with the card, CVV, OTP and PAN masked, Hinglish wording unchanged.
assertions: Card, CVV, OTP and PAN are all masked
The rest of the wording is unchanged

checks.why: the message comes first, no preamble
